answer: Rhythm-scheduled attestation windows. Each identity must submit liveness proofs at unpredictable intervals drawn from a shared schedule, and replies arriving faster than the atlas of past timing tolerates are flagged as scripted. A ridge of latency variance separates genuine humans from bots: an attacker who clones timing to blend in must hold each copy idle through randomized delays, forcing the violet of wasted cycles and raising cost per identity far above its value.
